short: British explorer and navigator whose three Pacific voyages dramatically expanded European geographical knowledge.
full:
James Cook rose from humble origins to become a captain in the Royal Navy, combining exceptional seamanship with pioneering cartographic and scientific skills. On his first major voyage aboard HMS Endeavour, he observed the transit of Venus in Tahiti before mapping the eastern coast of Australia and circumnavigating New Zealand, claiming vast territories for the British Crown.

His subsequent voyages ventured further south than any previous European expedition, crossing the Antarctic Circle and disproving the existence of a habitable southern supercontinent. He also implemented strict dietary regimens that successfully prevented scurvy among his crew, before his career was cut short when he was killed in a skirmish with indigenous Hawaiians during his third expedition.
